name: Lomitapide

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm

fda.text: RISK OF HEPATOTOXICITY JUXTAPID can cause elevations in transaminases. In the adult clinical trial, 10 (34%) of the 29 patients treated with JUXTAPID had at least one elevation in alanine aminotransferase (ALT) or aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≥3 times the upper limit of normal (ULN). summary: Lomitapide carries the FDA's strongest safety warning because it can cause liver harm and raise liver enzymes, which was seen in ten out of 29 patients in an adult clinical trial [3][4]. The drug can also harm an unborn baby and causes stomach or digestive issues in most patients [4]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests on people—rated the drug's heart score as high and its liver score as low [M].
